candidate_decisions.reason: Trusted channel evidence and exact 5:67 carriers support a bounded relay reading in which descent, messenger transmission, arrival, and the 5:70 history of successive messengers form one non-duplicative macro relation. All six nominated branches land in the finding, with no facet, context, or semantic obligation omitted.

The trusted channel evidence contacts the focus's messenger, message, delivery, and protection carriers directly. The four nominated branches are retained as one bounded continuity reading, and no facet, context, or semantic obligation is omitted.

The exact supplied HFT trace gives focus and context coordinates, attributed roles, a before/after reading, and a return to the focus. Its five unresolved branches remain attributed with null glosses and facets, while the resolved ب ل غ branch supplies the registered carrier; all six branches are landed without omission.

The exact 5:63 and 5:67 HFT trace supplies the omission carrier, the restraining and authority context, the changed reading, and a focus return. The registered branches and both unresolved attributed branches are retained, so the institutional counter-reading is bounded rather than expanded.

The exact 5:64 and 5:67 HFT trace supplies a released messenger, a held carrier, bound and extended hands, recurrent conflict, and divine quenching. Both registered branches and all five unresolved attributed branches land in the selective-protection finding.

The exact 5:66, 5:67, and 5:68 HFT trace returns through the focus and distinguishes the messenger's reaching action from recipients' establishing action around the same descending material. All three nominated branches land, with the repetition alternative kept visible in the finding boundary.

findings.title: Descent Becomes Delivered Speech
findings.claim: The focus presents revelation as a relay that must reach its public destination: what is sent down from the Lord is entrusted to the messenger and made to arrive through his delivery.
findings.mechanism: The focus's reaching, sending, carrier, message, and descent forms meet the 5:70 succession of messengers. The separate forms supply source, movement, carrier, content, and terminal arrival, changing a static descent image into a public delivery chain.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the difference between revelation descending and revelation becoming speech that has reached the people through a messenger.
findings.containment: The reading adds a relay and terminal-state image to the ordinary command to convey what was sent down. It does not erase physical descent, require audience acceptance, or turn the 5:70 history into a general theory of all revelation.

epistemic.reason: The channel material is trusted and the focus carriers are exact. The 5:70 target supplies an exact context occurrence and connection note, but the channel nomination remains review evidence rather than an independent lexical proof.

branch_activations.boundary: Dalın çekirdeği ulaşmadır; yaklaşma ve olgunlaşma, belirli bağlamlara bağlı ayrı uzanımlardır.

findings.title: The Carrier Is Held Against Interception
findings.claim: The focus's protection holds the messenger and preserves the message's path through a hostile human field, so protection functions as continuity of delivery rather than a detached promise of safety.
findings.mechanism: The carrier and message branches meet the delivery imperative and the protection verb. The protected person, the carried content, and the act of making it reach form one contact: outside pressure may confront the messenger, but it cannot sever the stated delivery chain.
findings.reader_payoff: Protection becomes perceptible as an active condition that keeps source, carrier, and audience connected while the command to deliver remains in force.
findings.containment: The reading preserves the ordinary sense of divine protection and the direct command to convey. It does not claim that every hearer accepts the message or that protection removes all human opposition.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supports directly nominate the focus carriers, and each activation returns through an exact 5:67 surface word.

findings.title: Delivery Remains Legible Through Hostile Uptake
findings.claim: The focus's completed delivery remains legible even when the addressed call is appropriated into ridicule or play and an inward response is concealed.
findings.mechanism: The focus's بَلِّغْ and بَلَّغْتَ carriers meet the public call in 5:58, its appropriation, ridicule, and purposeless play, and the concealed interior posture in 5:61. The destination's recoding or concealment changes reception, but it does not change whether the messenger completed the relay.
findings.reader_payoff: Arrival and uptake separate cleanly: the reader can see a completed public relay alongside several ways hearers may recode or hide what they received.
findings.containment: The ordinary requirement of complete delivery remains primary. The attributed HFT relation adds a hostile-reception test; a live alternative is that 5:58 and 5:61 describe only post-delivery reactions without affecting the conveyance shape.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has complete exact anchors and a strong changed reading, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and its unresolved branches have no independent lexical descriptors.

findings.title: Delivery as Enacted Intervention
findings.claim: The focus's conditional makes conveying an enacted responsibility, while 5:63's learned authorities supply a counterexample in which office and knowledge without restraining intervention leave the office unfulfilled.
findings.mechanism: The focus's تَفْعَلْ makes non-action consequential and meets بَلِّغْ as the required act. The 5:63 failure to restrain wrongdoing, alongside learned religious authority and harmful production, changes unfinished communication into a conduct-tested office.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the focus tests the messenger's office by an act rather than by title, knowledge, or the mere possession of a message.
findings.containment: The ordinary command to convey remains intact. The attributed comparison is limited to the relation between office and intervention; the rebuke of authorities may also remain an adjacent, independent admonition.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact 5:63 and 5:67 anchors and a focus return, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and the contextual branches without registry records remain attributed.

findings.mechanism: The focus's messenger and protection carriers meet 5:64's bound and extended hands, recurrent war-fire, and divine quenching. The surrounding motions contain the conflict field around the relay while the message remains the element that moves outward.
findings.reader_payoff: Protection becomes spatially legible as a held carrier plus an open route, rather than as a generalized barrier that would also restrain the message.
findings.containment: The ordinary protective meaning remains primary. The attributed image does not claim that 5:64's hand imagery is exclusively about transmission; it may concern provision, and the fire imagery may concern communal conflict without specifying this channel.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact 5:64 and 5:67 anchors and a strong changed reading, but its contextual branch identity is legacy_unbound and five branches have no registry descriptor.

findings.title: Delivery and Establishment as a Hinge
findings.claim: The focus distinguishes two responsibilities around the same descending material: the messenger makes it reach, while recipients make it stand in practice; recipient failure therefore does not retroactively erase messenger delivery.
findings.mechanism: The focus's delivery carrier meets the repeated descent and undertaking forms in 5:66 and 5:68. The same material is named on both sides, but the verbs separate messenger-side conveyance from recipient-side establishment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold conveyance and uptake as related but non-substituting acts: reaching enables practice without becoming practice itself.
findings.containment: The ordinary commission to convey remains intact. The attributed division is bounded by the flanking repetitions; a live alternative is topical repetition without a formal sender-recipient accountability split.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact anchors on both flanks and the focus, with complete returns through registered branches, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: The Source Opens onto All Worlds
findings.claim: The added 1:2 relation gives the focus's مِن رَّبِّكَ a wider governing scope: the source of the sent message is named in relation to all worlds, so the commission opens from a personal source relation onto universal lordship.
findings.mechanism: The focus's exact رَّبِّكَ carrier meets the exact 1:2:3 رَبِّ occurrence in رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ. The shared source word contacts the added all-worlds complement, changing the source frame from only the messenger's relation to a source named over a total field.
findings.reader_payoff: The source phrase can be heard as both directly addressed to the messenger and wide enough to hold the whole field of recipients.
findings.containment: The focus's ordinary 'your Lord' relation remains intact. This is a local overlay from 1:2, not a whole-surah claim and not a replacement of the focus's messenger-centered address.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 1:2 word coordinates are exact, but the added relation is an overlay review finding without an independent external branch record.
